seg.seg_note: Last quarter on the pre-spin five-segment structure (Test & Measurement, Environmental, Life Sciences & Diagnostics, Dental, Industrial Technologies) + Other. Fortive spun off 2-Jul-2016 (day after quarter end); from Q3-16 four segments: Life Sciences, Diagnostics, Dental, Environmental & Applied Solutions. Release has no segment table; segment sales / OP / depreciation / amortization and growth components from 10-Q Note 13 and MD&A (three-month). Growth tables are additive in the source (Existing + Acquisitions + Currency = Total); converted to the deduction convention (total + acq + fx = core). Release growth table labelled 'Total Revenue Growth from Continuing Operations (GAAP)'.
